vulnerability_title: [M-24] Launchpad slippage is not enforced properly during token graduation

recommendation.recommendation_text:
Consider calculating and checking the price per token the user is willing to pay and the price per token bought instead.

[View detailed Proof of Concept](https://code4rena.com/audits/2025-08-gte-perps-and-launchpad/submissions/F-80)

fixed_code_blocks.reasoning: This fix ensures that the effective price per token is calculated and compared against the user's maximum acceptable price per token.
